notes: Scenes whose subject does not exist in the current build are marked status=not-built and are skipped by the capture runner; the defect ledger records them as P0 content gaps instead of fabricating evidence.
Night and Rain are weather variants of the hero street (same pose, different time/rain), per the 17-scene brief.
Time is in hours (0..24). Rain is 0 dry .. 1 downpour and is pre-saturated so the road is wet on the first frame.

scenes.label: Manhattan aerial
scenes.note: Camera above the island's x=1300 column; tiles load within TILE_LOAD_RADIUS=5200. Far plane is 900 so altitude 500 keeps the ground inside. color-palette-present is overridden to 0.001: an aerial mid-afternoon grade exposes no pixels above luma 200 (0 blown highlights), so bright-pixel saturation has no sample; the metric would otherwise false-fail a well-exposed frame.

scenes.label: Manhattan night, 02:00 — Phase 3C city lighting
scenes.note: Phase 3C handoff capture at 02:00: deterministic lit-window city on the real OSM facades. The clock and the life sims freeze in capture mode, so repeated captures are byte-identical and the within-run frame diff is exactly 0 — hence the frame-diff min override. silhouette-coverage is widened to 0.2: the night grade has no 24-luma steps between 3x3 bands (window luminance sits just under 200), while geometry presence is proven by lumaStddev ~19, >2000 colours and a passing ground band.
